tip: Copy between two remote hosts through the local host.
This is the default mode; see -R for a direct transfer.
Force the use of IPv4 addresses only.
Force the use of IPv6 addresses only.

option.name: -A
tip: Allow forwarding of the ssh-agent to the remote system.
The default is not to forward an authentication agent.

option.name: -B
tip: Select batch mode, which prevents asking for passwords or passphrases.

option.name: -c
tip: Select the cipher to use for encrypting the data transfer.
This option is directly passed to ssh.

option.name: -C
tip: Enable compression by passing -C to ssh.

option.name: -D
tip: Connect directly to a local SFTP server program instead of a remote one via ssh.
This is useful for debugging the client and server.

option.name: -F
tip: Specify an alternative per-user configuration file for ssh.
This option is directly passed to ssh.

option.name: -i
tip: Select the file from which the identity (private key) for public key authentication is read.
This option is directly passed to ssh.

option.name: -J
tip: Connect to the target host through the given jump host.
Multiple jump hops may be separated by commas.
This is a shortcut for the ProxyJump configuration directive and is directly passed to ssh.

option.name: -l
tip: Limit the used bandwidth, specified in Kbit/s.

option.name: -o
tip: Pass options to ssh in the format used in ssh_config(5).
This is useful for options that have no separate scp command-line flag.
See ssh_config(5) for the options and their values.

option.name: -O
tip: Use the legacy SCP protocol for file transfers instead of the SFTP protocol.
This may be needed for servers that do not implement SFTP.

option.name: -p
tip: Preserve modification times, access times, and file mode bits from the source file.

option.name: -P
tip: Set the port to connect to on the remote host.
This is capitalized because -p preserves times and mode bits.

option.name: -q
tip: Quiet mode.
Disable the progress meter and the warning and diagnostic messages from ssh.

option.name: -r
tip: Recursively copy entire directories.
Symbolic links encountered in the tree traversal are followed.

option.name: -R
tip: Copy between two remote hosts by connecting to the origin host and executing scp there.
The origin host must be able to authenticate to the destination host without a password.
(deprecated, will be removed in a future release)

option.name: -S
tip: Specify the program to use for the encrypted connection.
The program must understand ssh options.

option.name: -T
tip: Disable strict filename checking of received filenames.
This trusts that the server will not send unexpected filenames.

option.name: -v
tip: Verbose mode.
Print debugging messages about progress.

option.name: -X
tip: Specify an option that controls SFTP protocol behaviour.
Valid options: nrequests=<value> for the number of concurrent requests (default 64) and buffer=<value> for the buffer size (default 32KB).
